{{Quote|His housing of agents at his home in Shad on Melinz, though a huge risk, has saved many deep undercover agents from capture.|Personal addendum by General Airen Cracken to an entry of a datafile detailing Rebel Alliance operatives dedicated to Ytavarg Aleema|<ref name="CRO">''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]''</ref>}}
The renowned [[Shockball/Legends|shockball]] player [[Ytavarg Aleema]] maintained a '''mansion''' on the<ref name="CRO" /> [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Melinz system/Legends|Melinz system]]</ref> celestial body [[Melinz]]. There, Aleema, who was also an [[Foster Agent|agent]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], provided temporary housing and [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] to other Rebel agents who were in need of shelter.<ref name="CRO" />
